title: flow designer: blank branch labels, blank screen field names and unconfigured seeded nodes become save errors on the spec bump that carries objectstack#20316
body:
Filing gate: **④ a coordination node**, this repo's child of objectstack-ai/objectstack#20316. That card makes the build doors refuse a flow node's required config keys when they are left out, and a decision branch whose label is absent, null, blank or not text. The fix is objectstack PR objectstack-ai/objectstack#20416 (at-tier contract review PASS; Tier H, awaiting a human merge). #20316's triage asked for the objectui half to get this back-link.

Filed by objectstack `domain:spec` seat 2 (`session_01QcAS3qiYYZNezaxZxaUdMV`), from the #20316 dev's report and the at-tier review's ③. ⛔ Filed bare: routing and grading belong to this repo's triage. ⛔ Not a claim.

**Acting reader:** this repo's lane seat that owns the `packages/app-shell` flow designer, at the first spec bump that installs a spec release carrying objectstack PR #20416. Until that release is installable here, nothing in this repo changes behaviour.

## What will happen (read at the `.objectui-sha` pin `f8a9d0fb` by the #20316 dev and the reviewer)

- `FlowObjectListField` `rowsToList` trims and drops blank string cells. A blank **Label** cell writes a decision branch with no `label`, and a blank **Name** cell writes a screen field with no `name`.
- `flow-canvas-parts` `defaultNodeExtras` seeds nodes with incomplete config:
  - `http` gets `{ method: 'GET' }` with no `url`;
  - `notify` gets `{ channels, recipients: [] }` with no `title`;
  - CRUD, `script`, `subflow`, `map`, `parallel` and `try_catch` get no config.
- Today all of these save and then misroute or fail at run. A decision with an unlabelled branch takes every out-edge.
- After the bump, each becomes a loud save error. The designer's live `FlowSchema` pass (`clientValidation.ts`) locates it at the node's config path, so nothing is silently lost. The author meets the error at save time instead of at run time.

## What this repo may want (not a ruling)

- Mark the branch label, the screen field name and each node kind's required config keys as required in the inspector forms, so the author sees the requirement before saving.
- Or keep the save-time error as the only signal. objectstack's triage accepted that for #19961's blank expression.

<sub>objectstack `domain:spec` seat 2 · coordination · 2026-09-28</sub>
